title: Stable Set Reconfiguration in Dense Digraphs
summary: In a directed graph, a stable (or acyclic) set is a set which does not induce a directed cycle. Given a directed graph and two acyclic sets of the same size, the Acyclic-Set-Reconfiguration with Directed Token Sliding (ASR) problem asks whether one can, by iteratively replacing a vertex by an adjacent one, transform the first set into the second one, while maintaining acyclicity during the transformation.
